title: emergency contraception
content: very impressed with the practice. Submited an online form requesting emergency contraception. Was called the same day by a very knowledgeable doctor and received my prescription straight away.  Then booked in for an appointment later in the week for a long term solution.  All options were discussed fully and with kindness.  Urban Village have a great team from the reception to the doctors and nurses. Thank you
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
